parsed.name: 数据项
parsed.description: 用于科学成像与实验数据管理的软件数据对象，表示一个实验数据集及其标题、说明、会话信息、元数据、校准信息和显示关联，适用于显微成像等实验数据的整理、查看与分析流程。
parsed.description_en: A software data object for scientific imaging and laboratory data management. It represents an experimental dataset together with its title, notes, session information, metadata, calibrations, and display associations, for use in organizing, viewing, and analyzing lab data such as microscopy results.
